blocks.text: 91. And that these promises the calling from among the Gentiles should inherit, to whom also the new testament was opened up, [^irenaeus-demonstration-iv-224] Isaiah says thus: These things saith the God of Israel: In that day a man shall trust [^irenaeus-demonstration-iv-225] in his Maker, and his eyes shall look to the Holy One of Israel: and they shall not trust in altars, nor in the work of their own hands, which their fingers have made. For very plainly this was said of such as have forsaken idols and believed in God our Maker through the Holy One of Israel. And the Holy One of Israel is Christ: and He became visible to men, and to Him we look eagerly and behold Him; and we trust not in altars, nor in the works of our hands.
